# Star Beauty Supply

> Beauty supply store based in Pflugerville, Texas. A big, bright beauty supply in Pflugerville with a whole wall of wigs you can try on, aisles of braiding hair and natural hair care, and a team that greets you the minute you walk in.

- Phone: (512) 670-2694
- Based in: Pflugerville, TX
- Nearby areas: Pflugerville, Austin, Round Rock, Hutto, Manor, Wells Branch
- Google rating: 4.8 from 420 reviews

## Services
- Wigs & try-ons: A whole wall of wigs, and you can try them on. Ask at the counter for a wig cap and try on up to four.
- Braiding hair: Pre-stretched braiding hair in all the colors, stocked deep for box braids, knotless and twists.
- Natural hair care: Curl creams, leave-ins, edge control and deep conditioners for natural hair, from brands like Cantu and Palmer's.
- Lashes, makeup & more: Rows of lashes, everyday makeup and the little extras, from lash glue to body jewelry.
- Bundles & extensions: Hair bundles and extensions for sew-ins and quick weaves, with help matching texture and color.
- Hair station & styling help: A little station in the store for quick touch-ups, plus a team that shows you how to do it at home.

## About
Star Beauty Supply sits in the strip center at 2700 W Pecan St in Pflugerville, under a yellow BEAUTY SUPPLY sign with a red star. It is a big, bright store with wide aisles, a wall of wigs on mannequin heads and shelves stocked with braiding hair, bundles, lashes and natural hair care. What people talk about most is the welcome. Customers say they are greeted the second they walk in, no matter how busy it gets, and that the team actually knows the products: recommending a routine, helping a first-time wig buyer try on a few styles, then sizing and styling the one she picked so she could wear it out the door. Regulars say the same things on Yelp: the store is spacious and well organized, the staff understand their hair, and even if you run in right before closing, somebody points you to the right aisle and you are out in five minutes. One customer even left with the number of a local braider.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Can I try on wigs?
  A: Yes. Ask at the counter for a wig cap ($1) and you can try on up to four wigs. Someone can help you with color, fit and styling.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Friday 10 AM to 7:30 PM and Saturday 10 AM to 7 PM. Closed Sunday. Holiday hours can differ, so call (512) 670-2694 to check.
- Q: Where are you?
  A: 2700 W Pecan St #570, Pflugerville, TX 78660, in the strip center with plenty of parking. Look for the yellow BEAUTY SUPPLY sign with the red star.
- Q: Do you carry braiding hair?
  A: Yes, including pre-stretched braiding hair in lots of colors, stocked deep enough for a full install. Call ahead if you need a big quantity of one color.
- Q: Can you help me pick products for my hair?
  A: That is what we are here for. Tell us about your hair and routine and we will point you to the right products, from curl creams to edge control.
- Q: Can I call to check if something is in stock?
  A: Yes, call (512) 670-2694 and we will check the shelf for you.
